name: xo-server-tag-automation
description: Automate VM performance and permissions via tags and CSV

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: How often to run the enforcement cycle (Performance Sync, CSV Sync, Permission Autopilot).

dryRun.title: Dry Run Mode
dryRun.description: When ON (default), previews all changes in logs without applying anything.

enablePerformance.title: Enable Performance Sync
enablePerformance.description: Apply CPU weights and IO priorities based on VM performance tier tags (0-core, 1-high, 2-normal, 3-low).

enablePermissions.title: Enable Permission Sync
enablePermissions.description: Tags ending in -Admin, -Operator, or -Viewer trigger XO Group creation and ACL assignments.

enablePermissionAutopilot.title: Enable Permission Autopilot
enablePermissionAutopilot.description: Reads permission tags from current-vms.csv and preload-vms.csv and applies them automatically.

nfsSharePath.title: NFS Share Path
nfsSharePath.description: Absolute path to the NFS share directory (e.g. /mnt/v0/code/tag-automation).

stalenessWarnDays.title: CSV Age Warning (days)
stalenessWarnDays.description: Warn in logs if current-vms.csv has not been updated within this many days.
